discription: A simple pulse wave synth with an ADSR envelope, allowing control over pulse width.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, pulseWidth=0.5, gate=1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.6, 0.5, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
